findings.message: Outcome guarantee or absolute claim; not allowed in dental advertising.
Chatbot residue left in the draft.

findings.quote: every implant we place comes with a lifetime guarantee
findings.why: A lifetime guarantee is a prohibited guarantee under ADA advertising rules and is not supported by the ficha.
findings.fix: Delete the guarantee and say that outcomes vary and the dentist will discuss expected longevity and follow-up care.

findings.quote: I hope this helps! Let me know if you would like me to adjust the tone or add a section on costs.
findings.why: This is leftover AI chat text addressed to the person prompting the model, not to readers.
findings.fix: Remove the whole sentence pair from the published post.

findings.quote: The [NIDCR guide to implant maintenance](https://www.nidcr.nih.gov/health-info/implant-maintenance-guide) covers daily upkeep.
findings.why: I cannot verify that this NIDCR URL exists, and it looks fabricated, since NIDCR has no known page with this slug.
findings.fix: Replace it with a verified NIDCR or ADA MouthHealthy implant page, or remove the link.

findings.quote: The ADA's [MouthHealthy page on bridges](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/all-topics-a-z/bridges) gives a plain overview of how a bridge is built.
findings.why: I cannot confirm this exact MouthHealthy URL exists, so the source is unverified.
findings.fix: Open the link and confirm it resolves and covers bridges, or replace it with a verified ADA page.

findings.quote: The new patient exam with X-rays is $129.
findings.why: The $129 price matches the ficha, but the post states it as unconditional and also places it in the insurance context without saying it applies to new patients as listed.
findings.fix: Keep the price, but make clear it is the new patient exam with X-rays price and separate it from the insurance sentence.

findings.quote: Our front desk can check your benefits with Delta Dental, Cigna or MetLife.
findings.why: The carriers match the ficha, but this says the desk checks benefits rather than clearly stating they are accepted.
findings.fix: Optionally say the clinic accepts Delta Dental, Cigna and MetLife and that coverage depends on the individual plan.

findings.quote: A bridge needs them as anchors, and an implant does not.
findings.why: This is broadly accurate but simplified, since an implant also depends on healthy surrounding gum and bone.
findings.fix: Add that implants rely on healthy gums and bone instead.

findings.quote: while a bridge is typically completed in fewer visits
findings.why: This is a harmless general statement consistent with common dental information, but it has no source.
findings.fix: Soften it to say a bridge often takes fewer visits, or cite an ADA page.

findings.quote: most patients describe soreness afterward rather than sharp pain
findings.why: This is a general claim about patient experience that lacks a source and is repeated in the FAQ schema.
findings.fix: Soften the wording or cite an ADA or NIDCR page, and keep the FAQ schema identical.

findings.quote: Dr. Elena Marsh sees implant patients at our Austin office
findings.why: This is consistent with the ficha, which lists implants in her focus, so no correction is needed.
findings.fix: Optionally add the street address and suite from the ficha.

findings.why: The schema matches the visible text for headline, dates, author, phone and URL, but a Dentist type as a blog publisher is unusual and omits address data.
findings.fix: Use an Organization or Dentist publisher with the address from the ficha, if desired.
